messages:
alex: Kicking off canary for v2 on /v2/generate in us-central1. 5% traffic. tag=v2-2026-03-20

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started canary-id=canary-1849994321 target=5% status=in_progress

 maya: Quick heads-up: some partners still send `X-Api-Version` (capitalized). Do we normalize headers for routing?

 chris: Currently routing checks `x-api-version` exact key. Gateway doesn't normalize header case; might miss capitalized variants.

 liam: Saw ~0.02% 4xx from staging when header case differed. SDK 1.2.3 normalizes to lowercase but many clients on 1.1.x.

 alex: We cannot break older clients. Options: 1) pin unknown-header traffic to v1; 2) gate shim to normalize headers. What's fastest to reduce risk?

 maya: Header shim in gateway is quick. Lower customer impact and keeps rollout smooth. :thumbsup:

 chris: I can roll a header-normalize hotfix to the gateway in ~3-5m. It lowercases header keys used by routing only. Small rolling deploy.

 sara: Recommend applying shim before increasing traffic. Pause canary until shim is verified.

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Action: pausing canary-1849994321 per request. reason=header-normalize-required status=paused

 chris: Applying patch:
``
kubectl apply -f infra/gateway/patches/header-normalize-1849994321.yaml
```
rolling update -> 4 pods

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: gateway rollout initiated. expected_duration=2m status=in_progress

 liam: Sent upgrade notice to partners for SDK 1.2.3+. Not an opt-in auto-update for some.

 chris: Patch finished. Quick validation: logs show header keys lowercased; no errors. Perf unchanged.

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary resumed canary-1849994321 status=in_progress traffic=5% -> v2

 sara: Monitoring: P50 +4ms vs v1, within SLO. No 4xx spikes in canary bucket.

 liam: Added temporary client-pin feature flag: if v2-error-rate > 0.5% for 5m, auto-pin unknown-header traffic to v1 for 1h.

 alex: Add alert and runbook link. Also draft release note blurb: "Gateway now normalizes header case for api-version headers; upgrade SDKs when possible." Include rollback steps.

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: alert created: condition=v2_error_rate_canary>0.5% for 5m action=auto_pin fallback_runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v2-fallback

 maya: If stable for 20m we ramp to 25%. I'll post update at +20m.

 chris: Drafted release notes and partner email w/ curl example and mitigation steps.

 alex: Nice work. Keep oncall looped, publish release notes tomorrow 09:00 PST.
